episode: AI বাবল কি বার্স্ট হতে যাচ্ছে DeepSeek, Nvidia আর ট্রিলিয়ন ডলারের হিসাব

cast.host: vermilion top + charcoal trousers + blue visor

chapterCards: blue (#2638FF) capsule with white numeric box (০১,০২...) + medium Bengali sans title

beats.setting: Dhaka street at twilight — paper-cream ground, halftone sun lower disc, skyline silhouette, kite string
beats.visualIntent: Open on the paper-cream Dhaka street; halftone sun disc lower half; host stands left holding phone, blue glint on screen; title card center in ink black with white Bengali; top-left blue chapter pill '০১ · এক দিনে উdhao'; bottom swatch matrix and top vermilion progress bar.

animationPlan.anticipation: host raises head to look at phone over 0.5s
animationPlan.contact: phone screen emits blue halftone glow on touch
animationPlan.actionPeak: title card fades in, sun disc fully lit, host locks gaze on phone
animationPlan.followThrough: kite string sways secondarily, smoke from tea cart drifts
animationPlan.secondary: halftone dots sweep across sun lower half

beats.notes: Preserve paper texture; misregister 2-3px on title card outline; no recycled template — new street layout authored from script cue 1.

beats.setting: Host close-up on mobile calendar; calendar stamp red header; NY/Dhaka clocks side by side
beats.visualIntent: Host leans, sharp 45° arm bend inspecting phone; calendar card red top with misregistered black ink; dual time stamps NY/Dhaka; progress bar at ~10%.

animationPlan.anticipation: host tilts head down toward phone 0.3s
animationPlan.contact: finger taps calendar date, red header flashes
animationPlan.actionPeak: calendar expands, clocks pop in sequentially

beats.notes: Calendar prop from composer registry reused correctly; no recycled episode frame.

beats.scriptLine: আমেরিকার শেয়ারবাজার খুলল, আর কয়েক ঘণ্টার মধ্যে এমন একটা কাণ্ড ঘটল...
beats.setting: Line graph panel — NVDA line plunges from top-left to bottom-right over paper cream; red crash markers
beats.visualIntent: Graph line drops sharply; host recoils; red crash oval pulses; chapter pill updates; subtitle capsule bottom-left with vermilion bar.

animationPlan.contact: line snaps down, host body leans back with weight shift
animationPlan.actionPeak: -17% label stamps, crash oval blows to 2x
animationPlan.secondary: halftone dots sweep down with line

beats.notes: Graph authored new; no reused stock chart; red/vermilion crash label matches palette spec.

beats.scriptLine: Nvidia... এক দিনে তাদের দাম কমে গেল প্রায় ৫৯ হাজার কোটি ডলার।
beats.setting: Nvidia monolith — mega skyscraper; top block shears off; dropped block beside green cash stack (Bangladesh GDP)
beats.visualIntent: Top 17% block shears off monolith and falls to ground; host points down; green Bangladesh GDP stack stays upright; loss figure stamps in vermilion; misregister on block edge.

animationPlan.contact: shear line forms, block detaches, falls with weight
animationPlan.actionPeak: block lands beside green stack, dust puff
animationPlan.followThrough: host arm tracks fall, points at stack

beats.notes: Shear = 17% of height (~70px of 320); block uses same vermilion as protagonist top; green stack = Bangladesh GDP metaphor per taxonomy.

beats.scriptLine: ভাবেন একবার। পুরা বাংলাদেশ... তার চেয়েও বেশি টাকা।
beats.setting: Side-by-side comparison: fallen red block (Nvidia loss) next to green cash stack (Bangladesh GDP); magnitude labels
beats.visualIntent: Direct GDP comparison; red block visibly taller/heavier; host gestures between them; subtitle capsule bottom-left.
beats.notes: Comparison shot authored; no reused comparison frame; maintains cast proportions.

beats.setting: Host in center, wind lines, paper pieces blowing, clock rolling back; text 'এক দিনে' stamps
beats.visualIntent: One-day wipe; paper sheets blow across screen (halftone dots in wind); host leans into gust; stamp text pops.
beats.notes: Wipe transition uses halftone sweep per reference; no recycled transition.

beats.scriptLine: তো কী হইছিল? যুদ্ধ? মহামারী? না।
beats.setting: Two note cards on desk — left 'যুদ্ধ?' crossed out red; right 'মহামারী?' crossed out red; camera pans to small building
beats.visualIntent: Crossed-out note cards; small building label; red cross strokes misregistered 2px; camera pans to lab.

animationPlan.actionPeak: cards flip to crossed state, lab appears

beats.notes: Note cards new props from composer registry (card prop); crosses use vector line with 2px offset per misregister spec.

beats.scriptLine: চীনের একটা ছোট্ট... আর সেটা সবার জন্য ফ্রি করে দিছে। ব্যস।
beats.setting: Small Chinese lab building; blue orb glows at door; red rubber stamp 'সবার জন্য ফ্রি'; host observing
beats.visualIntent: Blue orb emits halftone glow; red rubber stamp on orb; lab small against skyline; host leans in; subtitle capsule.

animationPlan.contact: stamp presses onto orb with misregister
animationPlan.actionPeak: blue glow maximum, stamp fully visible

beats.notes: Orb prop from composer; rubber stamp new label prop; free-release metaphor per reference taxonomy (recipe/card metaphor not used here — correct scene choice).

beats.scriptLine: এখন প্রশ্ন হলো... এত ভয় পাইল কেন?
beats.setting: Conference table, gray silhouettes facing tiny glowing blue orb; poker chip stacks 'টেবিলে ট্রিলিয়ন ডলার'; host at end of table
beats.visualIntent: Small orb vs massive chip stacks; silhouettes gray; host at head; subtitle; top-left chapter pill; bottom swatches.

animationPlan.actionPeak: chip stacks glow red, orb pulses
animationPlan.followThrough: host lowers hand, looks at chips

beats.notes: Conference table scene new; silhouettes from reference; chip metaphor per taxonomy; consistent gray extras + blue visor.

beats.scriptLine: এইটা বুঝতে হলে আগে একটা বাজির গল্প শুনতে হবে। খুব বড় একটা বাজি।
beats.setting: Blue chapter card ০২ slides over; step diagram starts; host turns to new chapter
beats.visualIntent: Blue chapter card ০২; step diagram arrow to 'আরো চিপ'; host turns; subtitle; progress ~75%; transition prepares Ch 02.
beats.notes: Chapter card blue per spec; step diagram begins Chapter 2 playbook (more chips -> big data center -> best AI -> full market). Authoring original — not copied from example episode.
